validation.accountId: The account ID is 32 hexadecimal characters

connections.title: DNS provider
connections.description: Cloudflare API tokens. aoox can create the DNS record of a domain for you and answer ACME DNS-01 challenges for wildcard certificates. The token needs Zone:Zone:Read and Zone:DNS:Edit, and is stored encrypted: it cannot be viewed again.
connections.dialogDescription: Create an API token in Cloudflare (My Profile, API Tokens) with Zone:Zone:Read and Zone:DNS:Edit for the zones you use, then paste it here.
connections.tokenHelp: Cannot be viewed again after saving.
connections.accountIdHelp: Only for account-owned tokens; leave empty for a normal user token.

domain.proxiedHelp: Off by default: the proxy needs to see the real host and answer certificate challenges. Turn on only if you know you want Cloudflare in front.
domain.overwrite: Replace an existing record with different content
domain.addedWithWarning: Domain added, but DNS needs attention: {message}
domain.needsProxyDns: DNS-01 is not enabled on this proxy yet (Infrastructure, Proxy).

proxy.title: DNS-01 certificates
proxy.description: Proves domain ownership through your DNS provider, so the proxy can issue wildcard certificates without port 80.
proxy.noConnections: No DNS connection yet. Add one in <link>Integrations → DNS providers</link>.
proxy.needsEmail: Set an ACME email for this proxy first: DNS-01 uses the same ACME account email.
proxy.tokenNote: The token is passed to the proxy container as an environment variable, so it is visible to anyone who can run docker inspect on that machine, like other secrets aoox hands to containers.
proxy.recreateDescription: Changing DNS-01 recreates the proxy: a few seconds without service for every domain on it. Certificates and other routes stay.

previews.wildcardHelp: Issue one DNS-01 certificate for *.{domain} instead of one per pull request. Needs DNS-01 on the proxy and a wildcard DNS record.
previews.wildcardNeedsDns: Enable DNS-01 on the proxy first (Infrastructure, Proxy).
previews.wildcardNeedsDomain: Set a preview domain in Settings first.
